malware_usage.name: 3PARA RAT
malware_usage.description: [3PARA RAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0066) is a remote access tool (RAT) programmed in C++ that has been used by [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024). (Citation: CrowdStrike Putter Panda)

claim_assessments.statement: Putter Panda uses or has used 3PARA RAT.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: httpclient
malware_usage.description: [httpclient](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0068) is malware used by [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024). It is a simple tool that provides a limited range of functionality, suggesting it is likely used as a second-stage or supplementary/backup tool. (Citation: CrowdStrike Putter Panda)

claim_assessments.statement: Putter Panda uses or has used httpclient.

malware_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

malware_usage.name: pngdowner
malware_usage.description:
[pngdowner](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0067) is malware used by [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024). It is a simple tool with limited functionality and no persistence mechanism, suggesting it is used only as a simple "download-and-
execute" utility. (Citation: CrowdStrike Putter Panda)

claim_assessments.statement: Putter Panda uses or has used pngdowner.
